name: tabtree
description: The Claude connector for TabTree — mind maps, kanban boards and whiteboards in your TabTree account — and the Claude Code plugin that ties a coding session to one card of a board.

plugins.name: tabtree
plugins.description: Ties a Claude Code session to one TabTree card: Claude knows what it is working on, even after /clear, and your commits land on the card. Ships the connector (twelve tools, team spaces included) and a vision/OKR workshop skill.
